title: Slurry line pressure drop
line: A steady flow FEA study of a shear-thinning power-law slurry in a 25 mm pipe.
description: Steady laminar flow of a coal slurry (power-law, n = 0.4, K = 0.2 Pa s^0.4, 1500 kg/m^3) through a 25 mm pipe, 400 mm long, at 0.05 m/s. The study returns the pressure drop, 44 Pa by the power-law closed form, and the blunted velocity profile.
thumbnailAlt: Velocity profile of a shear-thinning slurry in a 25 mm pipe, solved in RunMat
